APPROVE
The loop body is split into `JudgeCall` and `RouteTarget`, which drops `ExpressAndFastify` well under 15. The checks, their order and the skip paths all match the original, including the failed-chain fallthrough that the `IsName` check rejects. The `is not var (path, receiver, middle)` positional pattern null-checks the nullable tuple and leaves the variables definitely assigned, so it should compile cleanly; I reviewed this by reading the diff and did not build it.
